title: Implants for surgery - Guidance on care and handling of orthopaedic implants
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11034) covers Implants for surgery - Guidance on care and handling of orthopaedic implants. This Indian Standard which is identical with ISO 8828 : 1988 'Implants for surgery ™ Guidance on care and handling of orthopaedic implants', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ) has been adopted by the approval of the Medical Equipment and Hospital Planning Division Council, This standard was first published in 1984. Its first revision has been taken up and the standard is being published as dual number standard to align it with ISO 8828 : 1988. The text of above mentioned ISO standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following: a) Wherever the words 'International Standard' appear, referring to this standard, they should be read as 'Indian Standard'; and b) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards the current practice is to use point ( . ) as the decim
clause_3_terminology: Guidance on care and handling of orthopaedic implants
Implants for surgery - Guidance on care and handling of orthopaedic implants

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
